capture_policy: Retain decoded ESRI JSON response bodies, exact HTTP wire bodies, request receipts, native IDs, field declarations, attributes, rings and coordinate order. Candidate GeoParquet preserves declared source field types and native EPSG:4326 geometry without reprojection or repair.
completeness_policy: Check source directory and layer identity, all declared field names/types, CRS representations, pinned layer extent, independent count/ID rosters before and after extraction, all explicit-ID pages, native attribute types, geometry structure/ordinates/validity and complete feature ID roster. Quarantine incomplete captures and drift.
coverage_scope: Complete observed IENC PYLONS_AREA chart feature class for inland navigation coverage. Not a national census of pylons or all navigable-waterway structures.
